## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home exercise for the SRE role was built, tested, and moved to its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` (compose stack with planted bugs, Terraform, 3-hour time box, no Kubernetes), plus a rubric with scores as panel input. The `hiring/` folder was removed from the infra branch `maya/sre-take-home` (uncommitted), no PR opened in infra, and nothing was sent to the candidate.

- [en-cours] `hiring/` removed from infra branch working tree but not committed; Maya plans to drop the branch
- [prochaine-étape] Maya sends the exercise to Ethan herself after Thursday's call (4pm Tel Aviv time)
- [prochaine-étape] Add Ethan as collaborator on the private repo when ready
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch build with `--load` failed (docker exporter can't export manifest lists); solved by having compose build flaky-svc from source
- [décision] No Kubernetes, 3-hour max, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] No scoring threshold; panel (Maya + Noa) decides, scores are input (source: t10)
- [décision] No email to anyone; Maya sends the exercise herself (source: t16)
